_comment: Copy to config.json and change what you need. Anything left out uses the defaults in server.py.
_location: Normally leave lat/lon null: the board uses the postcode entered for each Wi-Fi network. Set them only to pin it for good.
_theme: Board style: solari, terminal, ivory, cockpit, crt, racing, jetage, paper, wavepunk, graphite or sunflower (see STYLES.md)
_birthday: Alex's birthday as MM-DD, e.g. 11-22. Shows a birthday surprise on the day. null to turn off.
name: Alex
_radius: Starting radar range in miles. Alex can switch between 10, 15 and 25 on the phone page.
_map: Optional: a free CARTO key gives a darker, cleaner map than the default OpenStreetMap style. https://carto.com/basemaps/apikey/
_contact: Sent to the free data services so they know who's asking. Planespotters requires a contact URL or email.
_updates: Remote updates come from github.com/henewi/alx-board releases (see UPDATES.md). Set update_repo to "" to turn them off. Token only needed for a private repo.
_cache: Where location, route and map caches are saved. On the Pi, set this to a writable folder once the SD card is read-only.
